text.ko: 업종 내 매우 약함. 약점: 영업이익률 2.2%.
text.en: Very weak within its sector. Weakness: Operating margin 2.2%.

text.en: Strong within its sector. Strength: Revenue growth consistency 100%. Weakness: 3-yr EPS growth (annual) -50.0%.

text.en: Strong within its sector. Strength: Liabilities to equity 27.6%. Weakness: Intangibles and goodwill share of assets 65.6%.

text.ko: 업종 내 약한 편. 강점: 주가순자산비율(PBR) 1.52x. 약점: EV/EBITDA 34.74x.
text.en: Weak within its sector. Strength: Price to book 1.52x. Weakness: EV/EBITDA 34.74x.

text.ko: 현재 경제 환경이 이 업종에 불리한 편이에요. 주요 요인: 금리 상승 국면 (불리). 부채가 적어 금리 영향은 덜해요.
text.en: The current economy tends to work against this sector. Main factor: rising rates (hurts). Low debt cushions rate effects.
